title: Adding a field to scout team limits touches resolver, dataclass, serializer, and generated schema
answers: How do I add a new per-team limit to the scout metadata endpoint?
Which files change when ScoutLimitsSerializer gets a new field?
body:
A new per-project scout limit under the `signals-scout` payload changes together:
- `team_limits.py`: a `TEAM_CONFIG_*` key constant, a resolver, the `ScoutTeamLimits` dataclass field, `ScoutTeamMetadata.as_dict`, and `resolve_team_metadata`.
- `serializers.py`: `ScoutLimitsSerializer` field (with help_text).
- Regenerate `products/signals/frontend/generated/api.schemas.ts` with `hogli build:openapi`; do not hand-edit.
- Update `scout_harness/AGENTS.md` (`team_limits.py` entry) and the comment beside the constant in `limits.py`.
Tests for resolver matrices live in `test_scout_coordinator.py`; API and status behavior in `test_scout_harness_api.py` and `test_scout_status.py`.
applies: scout metadata/limits API changes in products/signals
